mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, product_id, product_name, unit_price, quantity, subtotal) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotal})
mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.unit_price, oi.quantity, oi.subtotal, c.name AS category_name, p.status AS current_product_status FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id
